data_objects.name: daily_adjusted_ohlcv_bars
data_objects.meaning: Daily open-high-low-close prices, adjusted close, and trading volume for one unidentified traded asset.
data_objects.notes: Rows are chronological and blank CSV cells encode unavailable market fields.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the market bar.

variables.name: Close
variables.meaning: Unadjusted closing price for the date.

variables.name: Adj Close
variables.meaning: Closing price after the source's adjustment convention.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Traded volume associated with the date.

structure.description: Each row is one daily OHLCV bar; Date is the temporal identifier and rows are ordered chronologically.
Close and Adj Close are parallel raw and adjusted closing-price representations; empty fields encode unavailable values.

uncertainties: The asset, venue, market calendar, and time-zone convention are not identified.
The price currency, the adjustment rule behind Adj Close, and the units represented by Volume are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
